comparison.objective: Tighten fifteen pool balls into a legal rack, place the head ball on the foot spot, and lift the triangle away without disturbing them.
comparison.physical_skill: Compacting free-rolling objects inside a frame and extracting that frame vertically without imparting lateral motion.
comparison.success_condition: All 30 neighboring pairs are within 0.5 mm, the head ball is within 5 mm of the spot, the rack and hands are clear, and balls are still; disturbance during rack removal is latched.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is group compaction and disturbance-free frame removal, unrelated to preserving a threaded angular setting through jam-nut tightening and repeated actuation.
